description: This file defines the Mail class within the Opencart system, providing functionality for composing and sending emails with support for HTML, attachments, and various headers.

classes.name: Mail
classes.description: A class for constructing and sending emails with support for HTML content, attachments, and custom headers.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Mail object with optional configuration options.

methods.name: setTo
methods.description: Sets the recipient(s) of the email.

methods.name: setSender
methods.description: Sets the sender's name or email.

methods.name: setText
methods.description: Sets the plain text body of the email.

methods.name: setHtml
methods.description: Sets the HTML body of the email.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Constructs and sends the email, supporting attachments and multipart content.
